name: dsh-notch
description: Show Claude Code sessions, permission prompts and questions in the native macOS DSH Notch; answer them from the screen edge.

helper_path.title: Notch helper executable
helper_path.description: Absolute path to the extracted dsh-notch executable (keep DshNotch_DshNotch.bundle beside it). When set, the plugin starts and supervises the helper. Leave empty to start it yourself.

approval_wait_seconds.title: Answer-from-Notch window (seconds)
approval_wait_seconds.description: How long a permission prompt or AskUserQuestion stays answerable in Notch. Answering in Claude Code first always wins. 0 shows status only.
